reviews.text: Lovely place, amazing staff, good luck with the project !
The best groomers in Northeast London!

My cockapoo is very nervous, especially with grooming. The staff at wagworks were so kind with him and really did their best to make him feel comfortable. It’s so comforting to know you’re leaving your dog with such lovely people!

The arrival of Wagworks to Upper Street has given me the opportunity to provide my puppy Miguelito with a more exciting and varied weekly routine. Given that Miguelito is a bit more sensitive to changes, and has a food allergy, having the chance to socialize more and to be looked after and supported by well trained, conscientious staff,  plus the interaction with dogs of all sizes and temperaments, has had a very positive effect on him.
The setting is modern, clean, well kept and offers a variety of areas with comprehensive environments to stimulate and to cater for all the needs of dogs in a structured, safe, fun and caring urban space. Highly recommended.

Best daycare out there. My Maltese has an absolute blast. She skips up the street in the mornings to the door, and gets lots of cuddles, kisses, and enrichment time during the day. She sleeps for the evening when she gets home from all the play time.
I feel really comfortable leaving her there for the day and I know that she’s having the best time of her life ❤️

When my boy first joined, he was such a shy and reserved little grumpy boy, but it’s been so lovely seeing him become happier, more confident, and more relaxed with Wagworks. I really appreciate all the care and love from the team — it truly means a lot to us.

Our cockapoo, Lina, has been attending daycare for the past few weeks, and both she and we have been absolutely delighted with the team and facilities. Every member of staff we’ve met has been warm, friendly, and excellent at communicating. It’s clear they genuinely care about Lina, and we always feel she’s in the very best hands.

A huge thank you to the entire team for all the care, attention, and hard work you put in every day.
The best doggie daycare in London!  Lovely staff and our dog loves it there!

Absolutely incredible! I looked at lots of daycares and nothing came close to WagWorks. Bella runs from the station everyday and never wants to leave. She is so well behaved and socialised. Couldn’t ask for a better team!

Finn has been going to WagWorks since the day they opened, and I truly can’t recommend them enough.

He’s a very friendly, high-energy dog who needed to learn better “dog manners” and how to engage appropriately without overwhelming others. What sets WagWorks apart from typical daycares is that they’re not just supervising play — they’re actively helping dogs grow. They take the time to understand each dog individually, and Finn’s progress has been incredible to see.

One of the biggest things they’ve helped with is teaching him how to self-settle. They recognise when he’s ramping up and gently guide him to pause and reset, so he doesn’t just build and build in excitement. That kind of thoughtful coaching is invaluable — a more stable dog is a happier dog. They balance physical exercise and socialisation with enrichment and mental stimulation, which Finn responds to so well.

Because he lives alone, having a safe, structured environment for him to socialise and learn in is so important to me. I know he’s supported every minute he’s there, and I love receiving updates and seeing in the photos how much more balanced and confident he’s becoming.

The team is also just genuinely lovely — kind, professional, and clearly invested in every dog. And their opening hours (from 7am on weekdays and open Saturdays!) have been such a game changer for me.

Finn is ecstatic every time he arrives — and slightly less enthusiastic about leaving! I’m so grateful we found them.

I’m so happy I found WagWorks. I was a little unsure before joining, as I questioned whether my dog should be spending more time outdoors. But I have no regrets. He gets a walk outdoors, indoor play and indoor quiet time. My dog is so excited to go and the staff are wonderful. I love that they give report cards and that their in-house behaviourist works with the owner if there are any challenges the dog is facing. Also love the convenience of an in-house vet and the hours they operate (including Saturdays). It may seem costly, but I think mid- and top tiers work out well for what you’re getting. I would very much recommend. For reference, I’ve been a member for two months.

We honestly couldn’t recommend WagWorks Islington more highly. Our cocker spaniel puppy, Rolo, absolutely loves it there and the staff are truly incredible. The team went above and beyond for us when I unexpectedly went into labour and we urgently needed support with Rolo — something we’ll never forget. We also love the app (the updates are such a comfort), and the on-site vet care and grooming services make everything feel so easy and well looked after. Yes, it’s on the pricier side, but if it’s within your budget, it’s 100% worth it for the care, kindness and total peace of
Canine Disneyland. Leo our puppy loves it here.

The team are absolutely lovely, and you know they love every single dog. They’re so attentive and I completely trust them when I drop Stanley off as they clearly care about him. (And he is always excited when we get there)

We know Stanley has such a good time whilst there, we get updates throughout the day on what he is up to, and this ranges from, training, agility, scent work and who he is playing with.

WagWorks is absolutely amazing! Our little border terrier loves his time there.
They are so good at keeping him entertained!
Thank you!!
Wonderful addition to the area, great service and caring people. Thanks for creating a new home away from home for Audrey!

Absolutely fantastic dog daycare!
Our 3.5-year-old very energetic boxer has been going here for a while now, and we honestly couldn’t be happier. The team is warm, patient, and clearly knows exactly how to handle high-octane pups like ours. She sprints through the door without even looking back — which says everything!
The staff keeps us updated, genuinely cares about each dog, and provides the perfect mix of play, structure, and affection. We’ve noticed such a positive change in her behaviour and confidence since she started. By the time we pick her up, she’s joyful, tired (in the best way), and completely content.
If you have a lively dog who needs a safe, fun, and truly caring place in Islington, this daycare is an absolute gem. Highly, highly recommend! 🐾💛

Our Labrador absolutely loves WagWorks! As someone who initially worried about sending my dog to daycare, I didn't need to - the experience has been nothing but positive.

She is always so excited to see the staff, which is the best sign that she's having a great time. When she comes home, she is perfectly calm, happy, and never over-stimulated. We also really appreciate the picture and video updates we receive throughout the day. Highly recommend WagWorks Islington!

Wagworks has been an amazing experience for our dog. The staff are super friendly and helpful, whilst the flexibility around pick up and drop off has been something which really separates it from others.

The onsite vet and grooming is always a great resource. I would strongly recommend it to anyone with a dog who is looking for daycare

My partner and I absolutely love Wagworks! Our pup Winnie is always so excited to go in and we know she's looked after well, resting and having lots of fun with her new best friends. She used to be quite stressed and anxious at her last daycare but has calmed down and become much more confident since she moved to Wagworks. Highly recommend this daycare to anybody nearby!
My dog has zero separation anxiety at WagWorks and is pawing at the door to join other pups for an enriching day! Thank you WagWorks team for excellent care.

My 6 month old cavapoo is the MOST excited every time we get near WagWorks. I literally have to drag him away when picking him up. The facilities are incredible (it’s my favourite place in London and I never pass reception). The team is fantastic - super welcoming, very helpful, and our puppy adores each and every one of them.

As a young city pup, it was really important for us that he gets socialised in a safe environment. WagWorks has been outstanding on that front and I couldn’t recommend them highly enough. Worth every penny.

Pumped to have WagWorks Islington nearby! Gino (our little sausage) absolutely loves it here.

The staff are brilliant, totally devoted to the dogs. The daycare is the best around, wouldn’t go anywhere else. Gino always comes home wagging his tail. Awesome company, recommend always.

So glad that WagWorks is now in Islington! This has been a total game-changer for me and my dog. The staff are super knowledgeable but most importantly they treat every dog like their own.

The daycare is clean, calm and beautifully run - it's a bit like a Montessori school for dogs. I love that everything from training to healthcare and grooming is under one roof so I can drop off and everything is taken care of. Love it, thanks so much guys!!

These guys go above and beyond for your dog - they really have thought of everything and I totally trust them with my pup Lenny! He absolutely loves it there! So different to your average day care, highly recommend
